angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 14,630,571 km at 75.64 pc = 2.59 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 84441: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 13.22 +/- 0.15 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b): 75.643 +/- 0.858 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 14.3394 +/- 0.3209 mas (same row, RUWE 3.45), 44.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 21.03 +/- 0.32 solar radii from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 84441: radius 21.03 +0.32/-0.31 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 2.587 +/- 0.025 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b): 14,630,571 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.71 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 84441: mass 3.71 +/- 0.04 solar masses (Table 6), from the PARAM Bayesian fit to PARSEC isochrones at the measured temperature; the paper calls its masses estimates only (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5623 +/- 75 K from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 84441: effective temperature 5623 +/- 75 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 84441: effective temperature 5623 +/- 75 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/epsilon-leonis.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.362, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * eps Leo: spectral type G1IIIa (1989ApJS...71..245K)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * eps Leo: main object type *, Star
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * eps Leo: projected rotation speed 8.1 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2008AJ....135..209M)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
